subject: Performance coaching: Dylan Brooks — 30-day plan and next steps
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Concerns re: dylan_brooks & request for pre-PIP coordination

Team —

I wanted to flag an ongoing performance concern with Dylan Brooks (Eng, Platform) that I think requires formalized short-term coaching before we consider PIP. High-level summary: missed SLAs on three sprint deliverables (Jan sprint and two follow-ups), repeated vague status updates to stakeholders, and a recent code review that required significant rework for basic integration patterns. I have anecdotal examples below; I can share the PRs and time logs if you want them.

Why I’m escalating now: informal 1:1 notes and peer feedback haven’t produced sustained improvement over the last two months. My preference is to run a timeboxed 30-day coaching plan with clear, measurable expectations and two planned check-ins. If progress is insufficient, we’ll discuss next steps with People.

What I’m requesting from People:
- A brief coaching template we can use that’s HR-aligned (confidential).
- Guidance on documentation and evidence collection for a pre-PIP stage.
- Confirmation on any required legal/benched language or involvement of employment counsel.

I’ve drafted an initial coaching plan (attached: coaching_plan_v1.pdf) and candidate examples of deliverable-level expectations. Confidentiality here is important — keep to People + leadership chain for now.

Quick context/examples (available in attachments if helpful):
- Deliverable: integration adapter for vendor X (Due 2026-01-21) — delivered with missing error handling and caused rollback in staging.
- Communication: status updates to FE/PM were often a single line with no acceptance criteria.
- Quality: PRs required >2 rounds for basic infra changes resulting in >8 hours of rework across reviewers.

Proposed timeline: kick off private 30-day coaching with Dylan on Friday 02/06, check-ins at 2 weeks and 30 days.

I’m available to hop on a short call this afternoon if helpful.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 04 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Concerns re: dylan_brooks & request for pre-PIP coordination

Thanks for the detailed note, Sean. This is helpful.

Next steps from People (confidential):
1) Use the attached coaching_template.docx as the working artifact. It captures expectations, evidence/examples, meeting cadence, and escalation points.
2) Document one-on-one notes and any stakeholder impact (PR links, dates, and reviewer notes) in the HR case file (HR-CASE-2026-087).
3) We recommend a private coaching conversation first (manager + employee) and a follow-up with People present only if you or Dylan want support.
4) Counsel: I’ve looped in our employment counsel option (samir.khan@thompsonsllp.com) only as FYI; not required unless there’s a legal concern.

Confidentiality reminder: do not forward coaching artifacts to broader org.

If you want, Monica and I can join the kickoff on 02/06. Please send the invite as private.

—
Stephanie Nguyen
People Business Partner
Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Feb 2026 08:48:00 -0800
Subject: One-on-one follow-up — expectations and 30-day improvement plan (private)

Dylan —

Thanks for taking the time in today’s 1:1. I want to be explicit about the path forward so there’s no ambiguity. This is a private coaching plan to help you get back on track; People is aware and will advise on documentation.

Goal: Demonstrable, consistent delivery of platform work that meets acceptance criteria and reduces reviewer rework within 30 days.

Concrete expectations (measurable):
- Delivery cadence: complete the outstanding adapter ticket (JIRA-PLAT-452) with full unit tests and integration checks by 02/18.
- PR quality: aim for <=1 substantive review round for infra-level PRs (no regressions, follow style/owner-checklist).
- Status updates: post an end-of-day note in the ticket with acceptance criteria and blockers; weekly summary to PM and me by EOD Friday.
- Communication: if blocked for >4 hours, escalate to the on-call owner + me.

Support I’ll provide:
- 1:1 twice in the next 30 days (02/12 and 02/18) to review progress and remove blockers.
- I’ll pair-review the first PR and leave inline comments.
- I’ll provide examples of concise deliverables that have worked before (see examples_of_concise_deliverables.xlsx attached).

Consequences: If we do not see measurable improvement by the 30-day check (02/18 meeting), we will consult People and determine next steps (which may include formal PIP).

Please reply to confirm you understand the expectations and the dates above. I want this to be a fair, clear process — your success here is important.

Best,
Sean
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: One-on-one follow-up — expectations and 30-day improvement plan (private)

Thanks, Sean — I appreciate the clarity and I want to improve. Quick clarifying Qs: 1) For JIRA-PLAT-452, do you want the integration tests to run in CI or is a local integration script acceptable for the 02/18 cutoff? 2) On PR rounds, should I address style/formatting before requesting review or will you handle that in your pair-review?

I’ll confirm formally after your quick guidance and I’ll post a short daily update to the ticket starting today.

—Dylan
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: 2-week check-in notes & next steps for Dylan Brooks (HR case HR-CASE-2026-087)

Sean/Stephanie —

This note captures the 2-week check-in and recommended follow-ups. Attached: 30_day_progress_notes.pdf (manager notes) and examples_of_concise_deliverables.xlsx.

Summary of progress to date:
- Dylan has committed to daily ticket updates and posted 9 updates since 02/05.
- JIRA-PLAT-452 is in review; unit tests included. Integration test is local for now — manager agreed that CI integration by 02/25 is acceptable given infra dependencies.
- PR quality improved; two substantive review points remain but rework was completed within expected timeframe.

Manager recommendation: continue current coaching cadence. Add a short pairing session the week of 02/23 focused on building the CI integration so the 30-day goal is fully met. If we do not see CI integration by 02/25 or a regression in quality, People should be consulted for a formal PIP discussion.

Notes on confidentiality and documentation: the above is filed under HR-CASE-2026-087. Please do not forward outside the immediate chain.

—
Monica Patel
Senior People Partner
Redwood Inference
